description: contrast-agnostic 18-class brain segmentation (T2w, FLAIR, T1w, PDw, ULF, FDG-PET; 24-channel)
_comment_gelu: Identical 24-channel 13-hidden affine-GN MeshNet architecture to mindmap, sharing the same exp2_sigmoid GELU, Metal shaders, CUDA fatbin, and HIP code objects with zero added kernel footprint.
_comment_norm: 5/95 rank quantile normalization (floor(n*0.05), ceil(n*0.95)-1) matching mindmap and the locked v6.2 non-T1 training/evaluation pipeline.
_comment_capabilities: Identical dilation ladder to mindmap (1,3,5,7,13,19,31,19,13,7,5,3,1); full-volume receptive field precludes --crop, and --mask/--border apply only to binary mask models.
